question: Should OpenClaw add a native ASR/STT backend abstraction for platform voice input, and which initial platform flow and security contract should it support?
rationale: The request is valid but cannot be safely reduced to a config toggle: maintainers must choose native app versus Gateway/media ownership, endpoint/auth handling, private-network policy, and fallback behavior before implementation.

options.title: Design native STT seam first
options.body: Add a maintainer-scoped native ASR/STT abstraction, start with the smallest approved flow, and reuse `tools.media.audio` or provider contracts where that is the chosen owner boundary.

options.title: Route through plugin/provider surfaces only
options.body: Close or narrow the core request if maintainers decide existing provider plugins and ClawHub are sufficient and native app capture should not gain a new backend seam.

options.title: Defer custom endpoints
options.body: Keep Apple/Android platform speech as the only native voice input path until security and UX requirements are clearer.

recommendation.title: Design native STT seam first
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-scoped native ASR/STT abstraction, start with the smallest approved flow, and reuse `tools.media.audio` or provider contracts where that is the chosen owner boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest native voice feature-history signal and is already mentioned on this issue’s timeline.
